{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
valid_ages = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(f'Valid age count: {len(valid_ages)}')
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age}')"}
